title: Help contact form has visible labels and says it hands off to your email app (SCAN-1030)
detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-22. The Help contact fields carried a placeholder and an aria-label only (WCAG 3.3.2), and the success state said the email was on its way when the form only opens a mailto: draft. Both fields now sit in visible labels, and the confirmation says nothing is sent until the visitor sends it from their email app. The accessibility statement drops this gap.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('components/frequency/site/pages/help/help-client.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(s.includes('aria-label=\"Your email\"'))bad.push('email field is label-less again');if(!s.includes('className=\"st-lab\"'))bad.push('visible labels missing');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-1030: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the Help contact fields lose their visible labels.
